title: Threads in the app: reply, N replies, the thread pane
spec: The app agrees to FEATURE_THREADS. ChatSession::reply and SignedInSession::reply send Request::Reply (Unsupported without the feature); SignedInSession::parents reads RoomView::parents. Command::Reply { room, parent, text } goes through the worker like a post (PostFailed on refusal), and the worker emits Event::Threads (Update::Threads) whenever a room's threads change. In the window any message can be selected and shows Reply (one's own also Edit and Delete); replies are left out of the conversation; a parent shows '1 reply' / 'N replies', which opens the thread beside the conversation (on a phone, in its place) with the parent, its replies, a 'Reply in thread' composer, 'Send reply' (trimmed, empty not sent, within MAX_DRAFT_CHARS) and 'Close thread'.
